task: Propuestas visuales del hero: mayor altura, panel blanco con patrón oficial y tarjetas institucionales

variants.title: D4 · Editorial con firma inferior
variants.prompt:
Create ONE polished Spanish desktop landing-page DESIGN MOCKUP IMAGE, not code, no presentation labels or surrounding device, based on reference 1 (the attached JSDP hospital page).
REFERENCE ROLES: 1 is the base to refine; retain its hospital photograph, navigation, institutional identity and informational content. Reference 2 (green sample card) gives ONLY the editorial arrangement, breathing room, delicate horizontal rules, a small diagonal arrow and pattern treatment: NEVER copy its green background or slogan. Reference 3 is the approved palette. Reference 4 is the exact full official JSDP-Sonora-11 logo to reproduce without redesigning. Reference 5 is the official government ornamental pattern; use its actual shapes in near-invisible light gray on WHITE, never burgundy on the main panel. No Amazon branding, illustrations, retail colors or retail words.
CRITICAL SPATIAL CORRECTION: make the photo hero substantially TALLER than reference 1. The white content panel on the LEFT and the four bottom category cards MUST NOT touch or overlap. Show a generous UNOBSTRUCTED BAND OF HOSPITAL PHOTOGRAPH below the white panel and above the tallest selected category card. Target at least 150 pixels clear gap, a very obvious separation. Do not just increase the white area under the cards. Extend the photograph section itself.
COMPOSITION: approximately 1600px wide by 1450px high, a desktop page seen straight-on, crisp legible text. White navbar across top around 100px tall with exact reference-4 logo at left, Inicio / Conoce la JSDP / Estructura / Documentos and green Iniciar sesión at right. Photograph extends from y100 to about y1050, much taller than original. Preserve recognizable brown hospital, palms, entrance and yellow flagpole, photographic realism. Main WHITE rectangular panel is in upper LEFT, leaves much of the photo visible, finishes by about y700. Category cards start around y900, across the boundary between photo and full-width white lower section. Real breathing room is mandatory.
MAIN PANEL: WHITE, sharp rectangular corners, subtle shadow, no colored fill. Apply reference-5 official pattern in extremely faint neutral gray, approx 4-6% visual opacity, concentrated left and lower area; keep text high contrast. Inspired by sample card's top identity, large central title, very thin separator near footer, lower action/logo arrangement. Use the EXACT full official logo reference 4 in the panel as well as navbar: IMSS emblem and IMSS lettering, thin GRAY divider, green JSDP, gray spaced Sonora, green/gold/gray underline. Keep proportions; not a replacement plain wordmark. Main title EXACTLY "Jefatura de Servicios de Desarrollo de Personal". Supporting paragraph EXACTLY "Órgano de Operación Administrativa Desconcentrada Sonora del Instituto Mexicano del Seguro Social." CTA "Conoce la JSDP" with arrow. Optional small top label "IMSS · SONORA". No invented slogan, statistics or factual claims.
FOUR CATEGORY CARDS: centered row, small relative to full hero, slightly PORTRAIT rectangular proportions width:height around 1:1.2. Every card has absolutely SQUARE 90-degree corners, NO outline/border, subtle clean drop shadow. All four use soft modern tonal GRADIENTS, never flat color or neon; exact official families. CONSISTENT ORDER AND COLORS: first "Unidades médicas" GREEN #002F2A to #1E5B4F with white thin hospital icon and label; second "Unidades no médicas" GUINDA #611232 to #9B2247 with white office icon and label; third "Personas" GOLD #A57F2C to #E6D194 with dark-green people icon and label; fourth "Coordinación" WHITE to very LIGHT GRAY (subtle #98989A at low opacity) with dark-green connected-nodes icon and label. Icons minimal simple coherent line art, located upper/middle, labels at bottom; restrained low-contrast official-pattern texture can appear at bottom corners. First card selected: 7-8% larger and modestly raised versus remaining three, no border or rounding even when selected. Cards have individual shadows and a 16-24px clear gutter. No carousel arrows/dots/play controls.
BOTTOM: FULL-WIDTH PURE WHITE section below cards, not another floating card. Ample padding and all content visible. Heading "Unidades médicas"; a discreet label "Texto provisional"; body "Espacio para presentar información sobre las unidades médicas y su relación con la JSDP." Hospital photo, enlarged first card and this description represent the SAME synchronized active state. The actual future interaction is automatic looping and manual card selection; this static comp shows only one frame. Do not write implementation notes in the UI.
Render as an exceptionally clean, credible institutional landing page mockup, detailed photographic backdrop, attractive real typography, exact Spanish accents, no misspellings, no card collisions.

VARIANT D4: a compact upright WHITE editorial panel x65 y160 w545 h540 finishing y700; generous 200px open photo gap before category cards. In panel top-left small "IMSS · SONORA" and a delicate diagonal arrow top-right, big refined dark-green serif title centered vertically in left-aligned three lines, support below. Fine gray horizontal separator above footer. Footer has small green CTA at lower-left and full official reference-4 logo at lower-right, both with generous space. Gray pattern very quiet on left behind text and footer. Category cards centered, normal roughly175x212 and first189x230; subtle diagonal tonal gradients. Lower section uses classic left-aligned serif heading and gold short rule. Preserve panorama and white composition.
variants.correction_prompt:
Perform a precise LAYOUT SPACING EDIT of this existing institutional landing-page mockup. Preserve all existing design and visual identity, all words and logos, white left panel, the same hospital photograph, fine gray official pattern, gradients, icons, card order, selected green first card and existing lower white text composition. Do not redesign, change font, recolor or remove elements.
Make ONLY these corrections:
1. Enlarge the hero photograph area vertically by adding enough lower photo/foreground area. Move the ENTIRE four-card row and the lower white description section downward together. Keep the main white panel in its current upper-left position and size. There MUST be an unmistakable large band of unobstructed hospital photo below the white panel: the clear vertical GAP from the panel's bottom edge to the TOP of the raised selected green card must be at least the HEIGHT OF ONE OF THE CATEGORY CARDS, roughly 190-220px at this rendering scale. The current gap is too narrow. Do not fill this gap with white; it must show the hospital photo. Increase the final canvas height to fit all content without shrinking the whole page. Roughly same existing width, about 1400-1450px height.
2. Make all four small cards a little more portrait-rectangular, ratio width:height exactly about 1:1.2; for example unselected 175px wide x210px high. The active first remains only about8% larger and slightly lifted. Keep all four icons and labels comfortably inside, keep individual gutters. Keep category order and respective green, guinda, gold and white/light-gray official gradients.
3. EVERY category card is an exact sharp 90-degree RECTANGLE: radius ZERO, no rounded corners at all, no visible border/outline whatsoever, no highlight stroke. Include only their existing soft subtle shadow. These rules apply also to selected card. Preserve excellent text contrast.
4. Below the cards retain the full-width WHITE area and all existing readable provisional description, with generous padding, fully in frame.
All else remains identical. The hero will be visibly taller with a substantial photographic breathing space between main panel and cards. No annotations, measurements, headings identifying this proposal or UI implementation notes. Deliver one complete crisp image.
